title: Consolidate semantic token deltas for micro-spacing, elevation curves, and table-row states
creator: Ava Chen
description: Background: Over the last 18 months we've accumulated multiple ad-hoc token variants for spacing, radius, and shadows across dense surfaces (tables, toolbars, compact cards). This has increased maintenance cost and caused subtle regressions when engineering maps tokens to runtime variables (CSS vars / runtime quantized tokens). Goal: Define a compact, semantically-driven token delta system that: (1) reduces the token surface by consolidating redundant steps, (2) introduces an opinionated elevation curve with 3 perceptual levels tuned for small surfaces, and (3) standardizes table-row interaction states (hover, selected, pressed) with consistent micro-spacing and press-depth choreography. Scope: audit current tokens used by buttons, tables, cards, and charts; produce delta mapping table (legacy -> new semantic); define elevation curve and shadow recipes; propose 2 radius modes (compact/regular) with compression mapping; update Figma token library and code token spec; create rollout migration guide for components and docs. Out of scope: full-scale color palette overhaul (separate initiative), reworking iconography, or large layout system changes.
acceptance_criteria: Token audit completed and mapped: every legacy spacing/radius/elevation token has a canonical semantic replacement
New elevation curve documented with numeric RGB/alpha shadow stops and live visual examples for small, medium, and large surfaces
Table-row state specs include exact spacing deltas, shadow/overlay intensity, and motion timing for hover/press transitions
Figma token file updated and push-ready; component instances in primary library updated to use new tokens
Engineering-ready token spec (CSS vars + runtime names) handed off with example PR to repo (token mapping + migration helper)
QA checklist and visual regression tests added for flagship components: Button, TableRow, Card, and CompactToolbar
tasks: Run token inventory script across Figma and codebase (identify usages)
Synthesize candidate semantic token set and delta mapping (3 spacing steps, 2 radii, 3 elevation stops)
Design elevation curves: create layered shadow recipes and perceptual tests for small surfaces
Define table-row choreography: spacing, overlay alpha, and press-depth timing
Prototype tokens in Figma; update sample components and capture diff screenshots
Draft token migration guide and create example migration PR in components repo
Work with runtime infra/ENG to ensure token mapping won't regress quantization paths
Run accessibility contrast and focus-ring checks for new elevation/overlay combinations
Schedule review session with ENG + PM and iterate on feedback
Prepare rollout plan: opt-in beta, canary components, and full migration timeline
notes: 2026-03-02: Kickoff discovery — initial inventory returned ~148 unique elevation/spacing/radius tokens across libraries. Noted heavy duplication for table and toolbar patterns.
2026-03-04: Design critique — recommended compressible approach: keep 3 perceptual spacing deltas for compact surfaces instead of current 5+ granular steps to simplify runtime mapping.

2026-03-06: Engineering sync — ENG raised concern about token churn affecting cache keys in runtime; agreed to include migration helper that maps legacy token keys to new semantic names at runtime to avoid invalidating caches.
2026-03-08: Accessibility review — Lina Patel (PM) requested explicit contrast checks for overlay shadows used in selected/hover states on tables. Added to QA checklist.
2026-03-10: Prototype feedback — compact radius variant preferred for dense rows; accepted with note to preserve focus hit target by keeping vertical spacing >= 32px on actionable rows.
2026-03-11: Decision: Use a non-linear elevation curve (perceptual emphasis at lower steps) to avoid heavy penumbra on small controls; documented numeric stop values.
2026-03-12: PR created in components repo: github.com/redwood-inference/components/pull/4482 — token definitions and helper migration function. Needs ENG review for runtime mapping performance tests.
Follow-ups: schedule cross-team rollout meeting, add chart-shadow regression cases, and track telemetry on token usage post-migration.
